title: Russian conquest of Chechnya and Dagestan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Russian conquest of Chechnya and Dagestan", at revision 1379926089, opens: "The Russian conquest of Chechnya and Dagestan, whose later phase from 1829 to 1859 is also known as the Murid War, was the eastern theatre of the Caucasian War of 1817–1864. During this campaign, the Russian Empire conquered the independent peoples of the Eastern Caucasus." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q23129421, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1817–1859 conflict in the North Caucasus". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
